```{r setup, message=FALSE}
source("Setup.R")
```

##### Macrophage profile matrix
The profile matrix was built once from the myeloid cells of Tan et al.
(`endo-2022_myeloid`) with the chunk below and is read from
`DATA_INPUT/reference`. The chunk needs SeuratDisk and the h5ad file
and is not run.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
library(SeuratDisk)
Convert(file.path(path_input, "reference", "endo-2022_myeloid.h5ad"), dest = "h5seurat", overwrite = TRUE)
seurat <- LoadH5Seurat(file.path(path_input, "reference", "endo-2022_myeloid.h5seurat"),
                       assays = "RNA", reductions = c("pca", "umap"))
norm_data <- GetAssayData(seurat, layer = "data")

subtypes <- c("M$\\Phi$1-LYVE1"       = "LYVE1",
              "M$\\Phi$2-peritoneal"  = "Peritoneal",
              "M$\\Phi$3-APOE"        = "APOE",
              "M$\\Phi$4-infiltrated" = "Infiltrated",
              "M$\\Phi$5-activated"   = "Activated")
cell_annots <- data.frame(cell_name = colnames(norm_data),
                          cell_type = seurat@meta.data[colnames(norm_data), "subtypes"]) %>%
  filter(cell_type %in% names(subtypes)) %>%
  mutate(cell_type = factor(recode(cell_type, !!!subtypes), levels = unname(subtypes)))

create_profile_matrix(mtx = norm_data, cellAnnots = cell_annots, cellTypeCol = "cell_type", cellNameCol = "cell_name",
                      matrixName = "CD68_matrix", outDir = file.path(path_input, "reference"), normalize = FALSE,
                      scalingFactor = 5, minCellNum = 15, minGenes = 100)
```

```{r}
profile_matrix <- as.matrix(read.csv(file.path(path_input, "reference", "CD68_matrix_profileMatrix.csv"),
                                     row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE))
```

##### Deconvolution
```{r}
spe_ruv <- readRDS(file.path(path_rds, "spe_ruv_d.rds"))
spe_sub <- spe_ruv[, colData(spe_ruv)$Segment == "CD68"]
meta <- as.data.frame(colData(spe_sub))

spd <- prepareSpatialDecon(spe_sub)
res <- spatialdecon(norm = as.matrix(spd$normCount), bg = spd$backGround, X = profile_matrix, align_genes = TRUE)
prop <- res$prop_of_all
```

##### Supplementary Figure 7
```{r, fig.width = 18, fig.height = 6}
prop_bars <- plot_prop_bars(prop, Macro, legend_title = "Cell types")
heatmap_grob <- grid::grid.grabExpr(draw(plot_prop_heatmap(prop, meta$Category)))
# b (heatmap) less tall than a, aligned at the top
FigureS7 <- plot_grid(prop_bars, plot_grid(heatmap_grob, NULL, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(0.72, 0.28)),
                      ncol = 2, rel_widths = c(1, 1.3), labels = c("a", "b"), label_size = letter_size(15))
FigureS7

save_plot(FigureS7, "FigureS7.svg", width = 15, height = 5)   # 15 in wide: prints at 50% on the page

# Single panels
save_plot(prop_bars, "FigureS7a.svg", width = 7.8, height = 6)
save_plot(plot_prop_heatmap(prop, meta$Category), "FigureS7b.svg", width = 10.2, height = 6)

prop_long <- prop_source(prop, meta)
save_source_data(prop_long[, c("AOI", "CellType", "Proportion")], "FigureS7a")
save_source_data(data.frame(AOI = colnames(prop), Category = meta[colnames(prop), "Category"], t(prop), check.names = FALSE),
                 "FigureS7b")
```

##### Figure 6c-e
```{r, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 3.2}
pc <- prcomp(t(log2(pmax(as.matrix(spd$normCount), 1))))$x[, c(1, 2)]

Figure6c <- plot_pca_pair(prop, pc, Macro, meta$Category)    # each plot with its own legend on its right
grid.draw(Figure6c)

save_plot(Figure6c, "Figure6c.pdf", width = grob_size(Figure6c)[["w"]], height = grob_size(Figure6c)[["h"]])
save_plot(Figure6c, "Figure6c.svg", width = grob_size(Figure6c)[["w"]], height = grob_size(Figure6c)[["h"]])
pc_df <- data.frame(AOI = rownames(pc), pc, Category = meta[rownames(pc), "Category"])
save_source_data(list(Florets = left_join(prop_long, pc_df[, c("AOI", "PC1", "PC2")], by = "AOI"), PCA = pc_df), "Figure6c")
```

```{r, fig.width = 12.75, fig.height = 3}
prop_results <- test_proportions(prop, meta$Category, meta$Patient)
save_tables(prop_results, "Figure6e.xlsx", rownames_to = NULL)

Figure6de <- plot_grid(plot_prop_boxplot(prop, meta, Macro),
                       plot_prop_bubbles(prop_results, border_fdr = 0.1),  # bordered: FDR < 0.1
                       ncol = 2, rel_widths = c(1.35, 1))   # wider boxplots; the row prints 536 pt wide
Figure6de

save_plot(Figure6de, "Figure6de.pdf", width = 12.75, height = 3)
save_plot(Figure6de, "Figure6de.svg", width = 12.75, height = 3)
save_source_data(prop_long, "Figure6d")
save_source_data(prop_results, "Figure6e")
```
